description: Registered FTSO providers on Flare or Songbird with each one’s measured delegator reward rate (annualised, after its fee, over recent reward epochs), fee, delegated vote power and whether it is over the vote-power cap. Rates are past results, not a promise; differences between steady providers are usually fractions of a percent a year.

sort.description: Order: highest measured rate (default), lowest fee, or most delegated.

name: get_ftso_providers
title: FTSO providers with measured reward rates
